senses.sense_definition: A large, powerful computer used by large organizations to manage many simultaneous tasks and connected terminals.

examples.text: The bank relies on a <w>mainframe</w> to process millions of transactions every single day.
Large corporations often use a <w>mainframe</w> to handle their complex data processing needs.

senses.sense_definition: A computer chassis that hosts and interconnects various hardware modules.

examples.text: The technician opened the <w>mainframe</w> to replace the faulty memory module.
All internal components are securely mounted within the <w>mainframe</w> chassis.

senses.sense_definition: The primary structural frame of a vehicle or similar machine.

examples.text: The accident caused significant damage to the vehicle's <w>mainframe</w>.
Engineers inspected the <w>mainframe</w> to ensure the structural integrity of the aircraft.
